## Personality

Stacy is a bright and sympathetic young woman who possesses a natural ability to win and hold the affection of her pupils. She demonstrates broadminded guidance in her work, combining tact and carefulness in her approach.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## History

Miss Stacy was hired as Avonlea's first female schoolteacher, quickly becoming popular among her students as she introduced field afternoons and organized a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to buy a schoolhouse flag. She encouraged creative writing, which led [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to form a story club, and eventually visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to propose forming an advanced class to prepare a select group of students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. Miss Stacy spent the following school year rigorously preparing her Queen's class for the daunting test before receiving an emotional farewell from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at the conclusion of the term.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as a beloved teacher, mentor, and role model for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who blossoms under her encouragement after returning to school. She inspires Anne's studies, engages her creative writing, and advises her to join an advanced class to prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can pursue a career as a teacher. The two share a close, warm friendship built on mutual admiration and academic guidance.

- Friend of — good friends and role model  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)</sub>
- Mentor of — advised Anne on taking up Second Year work at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>
